tagline: STIHL equipment and expert service for Auckland outdoors
heroSubheading: Sales, servicing and expert advice for your outdoor equipment
aboutHtml:
We're Craig Walker, Ben Deakin and Rae Deakin, and we run STIHL SHOP Westgate from 15 Kakano Rd in Westgate, just 200 metres from Costco. We opened because we know outdoor power equipment inside and out, and we genuinely understand what locals need to get their work done.

We stock the full STIHL range. Whether you're after chainsaws, hedge cutters, lawnmowers, trimmers, blowers, pressure cleaners or any of the other tools we carry, we'll give you straight advice about what's right for your job. We service what we sell too, so we're here for the long run with you.

Come in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday 9am to 3pm.
